question: What response patterns, support behavior and failure modes do raw local expansion, source-pose rotation-compensated local expansion and an available simple image-scale proxy exhibit in natural first-person motion?

data_partitions.identity_basis: Local video, frame timestamp and source-pose SHA-256 values recorded in the Discovery summary.

constraints.description: The Discovery cannot rewrite or rescue RGB_SEGMENT_CONFIRMATION_R1_NOT_EVALUABLE.
Frame timestamps remain ordered and the native pair sequence is preserved.
Observe response distributions, support, trigger density, temporal consistency and failures without requiring RCLE to win.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Run the unchanged pair core and temporal trigger on one predeclared continuous natural-motion sequence prefix before selecting a development question.
experiment_design.resource_budget: One locally available capture session, bounded pilots and one ten-second continuous pair interval.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop this evidence instance after the bounded continuous interval and record negative or ambiguous findings without tuning.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: Rotation compensation is intended to suppress rotational image expansion while retaining translational or object-approach expansion, but natural motion may expose different dominant errors.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Compares raw local expansion with source-pose rotation compensation on identical adjacent frame pairs.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Determines whether rotation remains a plausible dominant confound before further data collection or algorithm changes.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Describe fixed-denominator response and trigger distributions together with angular-speed association on the predeclared continuous interval.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Response distribution, evaluable fraction, three-pair trigger fraction and angular-speed association.
hypotheses.falsifier: Compensation does not reduce trigger density or angular-speed association in the observed interval.
hypotheses.resource_budget: Existing local ADVIO sequence and bounded host execution.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Do not tune on the interval; record the observed direction and move to a separately versioned mechanism audit.
hypotheses.selection_reason: Uses already available synchronized natural-motion data and directly tests whether the assumed confound is visible.

new_facts_and_evidence: 599 of 600 adjacent pairs were evaluable in the aggregated ten-second Discovery interval.
Raw and compensated three-pair trigger fractions were both 0.4000.
Compensated absolute response did not show lower angular-speed association than raw response.
weakened_or_rejected_hypotheses: The first natural-motion interval weakened the expectation that the current source-pose compensation automatically reduces rotation-linked responses.
unresolved_questions: Rotation direction and pose convention, lens distortion, motion mixture and chunk state resets remain alternative explanations.
reusable_assets: ADVIO adapter, pair ledger, response curves, chunk aggregator and focused tests.
next_high_information_experiments: Audit rotation direction, distortion correction and preselected high-versus-low angular-speed intervals before algorithm tuning.
governance_changes_needed: Use four result-access states, a ten-column capability map and session-level holdout allocation before development.
